notes: No accepted C++ submission (the recorded ones are a WA and a TLE that re-merge multisets per query). orig.cpp was written for the corpus: leaders form a max-weight basis of the subtree-capacity matroid, kept under a segment tree over time by insertion with rollback (slack on heavy paths, weakest chosen per subtree). It matches an exhaustive assignment brute on 400 generated cases with n, k <= 8 and m <= 7.
